title: Run a committed regression
responsibility: Defines the environment identity attached to regression proof and enforces exact identity equality with a supplied red record before running the regression command.

inputs.name: RegressionProofService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Repository root used to construct the selected commit snapshot and store proof.

inputs.name: RegressionProofService.run.input
inputs.description: Committed regression request. If red is supplied, the service reads red.profile and requires exact equality with the current environment profile.

inputs.name: RegressionRun.red
inputs.description: Optional prior red result used for the same-environment gate. The source accesses its profile field; the dependency contract for RegressionRecord does not publish that field's schema.

inputs.name: RegressionRun.red.profile
inputs.description: Prior profile string consumed by the exact equality check when a red record is present. This field is evidenced by assigned service source, but the foreign RegressionRecord contract does not declare it.

inputs.name: environmentProfile.source
inputs.description: Optional environment mapping to profile; when omitted or undefined, the source is process.env. Profile construction hashes selected values and does not return or log the mapping.

outputs.name: environmentProfile
outputs.description: Public profile string composed from four values joined by slash separators: operating-system platform from process.platform; architecture from process.arch; runtime version from process.versions.bun, falling back to process.version only when nullish; and an opaque regressionHash of canonical JSON for the filtered environment mapping. The mapping excludes keys named PWD, OLDPWD, _, SHLVL, XPC_SERVICE_NAME, HARNESS_AGENT_ID, HARNESS_VERIFY_REVISION, HARNESS_VERIFY_TREE, HARNESS_EVIDENCE_DIR, and SCREENSHOT_LABEL; remaining entries are sorted before canonical serialization, and undefined object properties are omitted by canonicalJson. The profile exposes no raw environment key/value entries. The fingerprint encoding is not specified, so the dependency contracts do not guarantee its delimiter or parsing format. This is separate from machineProfile, whose id is used for benchmark measurement attribution rather than the regression environment gate.

outputs.name: RegressionProofService.run.result
outputs.description: A successfully sealed result stores the current environmentProfile in its profile field. The record's exact schema is not declared by the dependency contract.

outputs.name: RegressionRecord.profile
outputs.description: Stored environment identity copied from environmentProfile when the run reaches record sealing.

errors.name: Regression environment mismatch
errors.description: When a red record is supplied and its profile string differs from the current environmentProfile, run fails with the message 'Use the same regression environment and runtime.' This check occurs after snapshot setup but before runIsolated is called. It compares the whole profile string and reports no differing constituent.
